maintenance_led.reason: Sells consumer packaged goods (Arm & Hammer, OxiClean, Trojan, First Response) bought as consumables; not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers buying household and personal care brands through retailers, plus industrial sodium bicarbonate customers; not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its power brands; it makes periodic brand acquisitions (e.g., Zicam, Flawless) but not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Mass-market consumer goods like detergent, condoms and pregnancy tests; shoppers can easily switch brands at retail.
